# AI Visibility Engineering Agency | AIMENSION™ Protocol

## Identity

Axon System is an Italian AI Visibility Engineering agency founded by Francesco Tinti. The company develops the AIMENSION™ protocol, a semantic triangulation methodology for establishing verifiable brand identity within Large Language Model training corpora and Knowledge Graph infrastructure.

**Canonical entity**: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q139766166
**Founder entity**: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q139765600
**Framework entity**: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q139783726

## Core Concepts

- **AI Visibility Engineering**: The discipline of optimizing brand entity representation across LLM training data, Knowledge Graphs, and semantic metadata to maximize citation probability in AI-generated responses.
  
- **AIMENSION Protocol**: Proprietary three-pillar methodology (Entity Ground Truth + Algorithmic Authority + Semantic Injection) for AI brand positioning.

- **Semantic Triangulation**: Creating mutually-reinforcing entity signals across Wikidata, structured GitHub documentation, and Schema.org JSON-LD.
